name: Shanghai Shenda Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Shenda Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, and manufacturing of industrial textiles in China. It offers automobile Interior decoration and acoustic components; carpets and accessory pads; sound insulation front wall, general sound insulation materials, and wheel arch linings; trunk decoration, packaging trays, and other interior parts. The company also provides technical services, development, consulting, and testing of acoustic products and automotive parts, import and export trade, garment processing and sales, property and leasing, as well as engages in the real estate business. Shanghai Shenda Co., Ltd was founded in 1986 and is based in Shanghai, China.
